title: Hooghoudt/Ernst IPOS 1..5 Response and Domain Readiness
principle: qualify mathematical parameter and branch domains before any production implementation
known_source_bound_risks: legacy reader accepts wetper=0 although IPOS 2..5 can evaluate logarithms containing wetper
legacy reader accepts zero conductivities although several IPOS formulas divide by or take square roots of them
IPOS 2/3 share an equivalent-depth helper with x<1e-6, intermediate, and x>0.5 formula branches
IPOS 4 has a derivative kink at gwl=zintf when kvtop differs from kvbot
IPOS 5 requires additional geometry/log-domain conditions not enforced directly by the legacy reader
legacy diffl<1e-10 cutoff is representation-sensitive and is not yet a modern normalized branch policy
